rome.name: Piazza Navona
rome.summary: Baroque oval square built on Domitian's stadium, with Bernini's Fountain of the Four Rivers.
rome.expect: Busy with painters and street performers; café tables on the square charge a premium.
rome.tip: Walk on to the Pantheon and Campo de' Fiori, all within ten minutes.
rome.why: The square keeps the exact shape of the 1st-century stadium beneath it, and Bernini and Borromini face off across it.
flow: Enter from the north end by the Fountain of Neptune.
Stop at the Four Rivers fountain and Sant'Agnese in Agone.
Leave by the south end towards Campo de' Fiori.
rome.bestFor: First-time visitors linking the historic centre on foot

rome.name: Spanish Steps
rome.summary: The 135 travertine steps between Piazza di Spagna and Trinità dei Monti church.
rome.expect: Sitting on the steps is banned and fined; expect crowds at midday.
rome.tip: Climb to the church terrace for the view down Via Condotti, then walk the Pincio to Villa Borghese.
rome.why: A Roman set piece of the 1720s that links the shopping streets below with the gardens above.
flow: See the Barcaccia fountain at the foot.
Climb to Trinità dei Monti for the view.
Continue to the Pincio terrace at sunset.
rome.bestFor: Walkers pairing the steps with Villa Borghese and the Pincio

florence.name: Piazza della Signoria and Palazzo Vecchio
florence.summary: Florence's civic square, with the fortress-like town hall, the Loggia dei Lanzi's statues and a copy of David.
florence.expect: The square is free; the palace museum, tower and secret passages tour are ticketed separately.
florence.tip: Climb Arnolfo's tower for a close view of the Duomo, and book the secret passages tour ahead.
florence.why: Seven centuries of Florentine politics in one square, with open-air Renaissance sculpture in the Loggia.
flow: Walk the square and the Loggia dei Lanzi statues.
Visit the Salone dei Cinquecento inside the palace.
Climb the tower if the weather is clear.
florence.bestFor: Anyone who wants the Medici story beyond the Uffizi

cusco.name: Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca)
cusco.summary: A striped red, ochre and turquoise ridge at 5,000 m in the Andes, reached on a long day trip.
cusco.expect: Very high altitude: the walk is short but hard, and a 3 a.m. pick-up is normal.
cusco.tip: Acclimatise in Cusco for at least two days first; horses can be hired for most of the climb.
cusco.why: One of the most striking landscapes in Peru, now on most Cusco itineraries.
flow: Early bus to the trailhead (about 3 hours).
Walk or ride up to the viewpoint.
Return to Cusco by early evening.

dubai.name: Al Fahidi Historical District
dubai.summary: Old Dubai's wind-tower houses, lanes and small museums by the Creek.
dubai.expect: Small and quiet compared with new Dubai; most of it is seen in an hour or two.
dubai.tip: Pair it with the abra crossing to the Deira spice and gold souks.
dubai.why: The best surviving picture of Dubai before oil, with the Dubai Museum and coffee and coin museums nearby.
flow: Walk the lanes and courtyards of Al Fahidi.
Look into a small museum or gallery.
Cross the Creek by abra to the souks.
dubai.bestFor: Visitors who want the city's older side

dubai.name: Museum of the Future
dubai.summary: A torus of steel and Arabic calligraphy with immersive floors about life decades ahead.
dubai.expect: Timed tickets sell out; the building itself is the main draw for many.
dubai.tip: Book online for a weekday slot and see the façade lit at night.
dubai.why: One of Dubai's most photographed new buildings, with exhibits on space, ecology and wellbeing.
flow: Work down from the top floor through the exhibits.
Step outside for the façade from the gardens.
